observation: First install rollback error follows RegOpenKey/RegRemoveValue/RegCreateKey in the owned user Installer Products SourceList; native error5 access denied. Later rollback errors affect further operations.
meaning: This narrows the next investigation to exact per-user installer registry/token/ACL state as well as compiler-independent control. It does not establish whether the base, native engine, policy or authored rollback caused the error.
